name: Bitwarden-Lite
description: Unofficial Unraid template for the official Bitwarden Lite self-hosted password manager image. This template is not supported, endorsed, or maintained by Bitwarden. It runs the official Bitwarden Lite single-container self-hosted image using SQLite by default for a simple one-container Unraid install. Before starting, generate an installation ID and key at https://bitwarden.com/host/ and set BW_DOMAIN to the hostname or IP address users will use to reach this server. SSL is enabled by default. Provide certificates in /etc/bitwarden, use the generated self-signed certificate for testing, or disable SSL when using an external reverse proxy.

paths.name: Bitwarden Data
paths.description: Persistent Bitwarden Lite data, generated files, certificates, and the default SQLite vault.db.

ports.name: HTTPS Web UI Port
ports.description: Container HTTPS port used by the Unraid WebUI button. Required when BW_ENABLE_SSL is true.

ports.name: HTTP Port
ports.description: Container HTTP port. Use only if SSL is disabled or when proxying internally.

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: Hostname or IP address where Bitwarden will be accessed, without a scheme or trailing slash. For local testing, this can be your Unraid server IP.

variables.name: Installation ID
variables.description: Installation ID from https://bitwarden.com/host/.

variables.name: Installation Key
variables.description: Installation key from https://bitwarden.com/host/.

variables.name: Database Provider
variables.description: Database provider. Default sqlite creates vault.db under /etc/bitwarden. Other valid values include mysql, mariadb, postgresql, and sqlserver.

variables.name: SQLite File
variables.description: SQLite database file path inside the container. The default stores vault.db in the persistent /etc/bitwarden appdata mount.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Container user ID. Unraid default is nobody.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Container group ID. Unraid default is users.

variables.name: Enable IPv6
variables.description: Enable IPv6 support in the Bitwarden Lite web server.

variables.name: External DB Server
variables.description: External database hostname or IP. Required for mysql, mariadb, postgresql, or sqlserver.

variables.name: External DB Port
variables.description: Optional custom database port. Leave blank to use the default for the selected database provider.

variables.name: External DB Name
variables.description: External database name. Required for mysql, mariadb, postgresql, or sqlserver.

variables.name: External DB Username
variables.description: External database username. Required for mysql, mariadb, postgresql, or sqlserver.

variables.name: External DB Password
variables.description: External database password. Required for mysql, mariadb, postgresql, or sqlserver.

variables.name: Enable SSL
variables.description: Set true for Bitwarden Lite to terminate HTTPS itself. If using a reverse proxy for HTTPS, set false.

variables.name: SSL Certificate
variables.description: SSL certificate filename under /etc/bitwarden when BW_ENABLE_SSL is true.

variables.name: SSL Key
variables.description: SSL private key filename under /etc/bitwarden when BW_ENABLE_SSL is true.

variables.name: Enable SSL CA
variables.description: Use SSL with a certificate authority-backed service.

variables.name: SSL CA Certificate
variables.description: SSL CA certificate filename under /etc/bitwarden when BW_ENABLE_SSL_CA is true.

variables.name: Enable SSL DH
variables.description: Use SSL with Diffie-Hellman parameters.

variables.name: SSL DH Parameters
variables.description: Diffie-Hellman parameters filename under /etc/bitwarden when BW_ENABLE_SSL_DH is true.

variables.name: SSL Protocols
variables.description: Optional NGINX SSL protocols override. Leave blank for Bitwarden recommended defaults.

variables.name: SSL Ciphers
variables.description: Optional NGINX SSL ciphers override. Leave blank for Bitwarden recommended defaults.

variables.name: HTTP Port Variable
variables.description: Internal HTTP listener port used by Bitwarden Lite. Keep in sync with the container port mapping target.

variables.name: HTTPS Port Variable
variables.description: Internal HTTPS listener port used by Bitwarden Lite when SSL is enabled. Keep in sync with the container port mapping target.

variables.name: Enable Admin Service
variables.description: Enable the admin service. Bitwarden docs say not to disable this service.

variables.name: Enable API Service
variables.description: Enable the API service. Bitwarden docs say not to disable this service.

variables.name: Enable Identity Service
variables.description: Enable the identity service. Bitwarden docs say not to disable this service.

variables.name: Enable Icons Service
variables.description: Enable the website icon service for vault item URIs.

variables.name: Enable Notifications Service
variables.description: Enable push notifications, login with device, mobile vault sync notifications, and related notification features.

variables.name: Enable Events Service
variables.description: Enable Bitwarden event logs for teams and enterprise event monitoring.

variables.name: Enable SCIM Service
variables.description: Enable SCIM for Enterprise organizations.

variables.name: Enable SSO Service
variables.description: Enable SSO services for Enterprise organizations.

variables.name: Proxy Icons To Cloud
variables.description: Proxy icon requests to Bitwarden cloud to reduce local memory use. Bitwarden recommends setting BW_ENABLE_ICONS=false when this is true.

variables.name: SMTP Reply-To Email
variables.description: Reply-to email address used by this Bitwarden server.

variables.name: SMTP Host
variables.description: SMTP server hostname.

variables.name: SMTP Port
variables.description: SMTP server port.

variables.name: SMTP SSL
variables.description: Set true for SMTP over SSL. Set false for TLS.

variables.name: SMTP Username
variables.description: SMTP username.

variables.name: SMTP Password
variables.description: SMTP password. Bitwarden notes that dollar signs are not supported in SMTP passwords.

variables.name: Yubico Client ID
variables.description: Yubico Web Services client ID.

variables.name: Yubico Secret Key
variables.description: Yubico Web Services secret key.

variables.name: Admin Portal Emails
variables.description: Comma-separated email addresses allowed to access the Bitwarden system administrator portal.

variables.name: Disable User Registration
variables.description: Set true after creating your initial account to prevent open public registration.

variables.name: HIBP API Key
variables.description: Have I Been Pwned API key for breach reports and master password checks.

variables.name: Real IPs
variables.description: Comma-separated trusted proxy IPs for NGINX real client IP handling.

variables.name: Content Security Policy
variables.description: Optional Content-Security-Policy override. Changing this can break Bitwarden features.
